lead.title: US AI chip curbs stall billions in Asia data center deals
lead.summary: Lenders have paused billions of dollars in loans tied to ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent as new US restrictions now require companies in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil to obtain government licences to buy advanced American AI chips.

top_stories.title: Xpeng says humanoid robots will do household chores, with IRON deliveries planned for H2 2027
top_stories.summary: Co-President Brian Gu said humanoids will likely be deployed in homes in the coming years, and the company plans to begin delivering its next-generation IRON humanoid in the second half of 2027.

top_stories.title: ElevenLabs in early talks to raise at a $33B valuation
top_stories.summary: The voice-AI company is in preliminary talks for a round targeting $33 billion, about 50% above its September mark, with ARR reported at $700M. The process is planned to formally launch in Q1 2027.

items.title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2 fixes recurrent state instability in long-context training
items.summary: Traces Gated DeltaNet-2 failures to asymmetric erasure operators whose directional gains compound across tokens, and fixes them with symmetric erasure plus decay-regulated residual writing. At ~1.6B parameters it raises the 128K RULER average by 6.80 points.

items.title: OS-Omni benchmarks generalist computer-using agents on long-horizon workflows
items.summary: A live benchmark spanning six platforms with tasks averaging 67.54 interaction steps. Best agent (Claude Opus 5.5) reaches 68.5% success against a 77.3% human reference, trailing humans by 25+ points on iOS and macOS.

items.title: Yandex releases AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base under Apache 2.0
items.summary: An 80B-total, ~3B-active MoE base model trained from scratch on 17.5T tokens with Kimi Delta Attention, Attention Residuals and Muon, with architecture ablations and scaling-law experiments included.

items.title: ShowNow: speculative streaming keeps responsive world models at 480p/16fps on one H100
items.summary: Uses playback-idle compute to prepare action-conditioned futures with single-latent commitment and shared-history tree execution, cutting median input-to-display latency from 620 ms to 208 ms on ViZDoom.

items.title: vSFT learns to verbally tune agents at test time
items.summary: A supervisor turns an agent's failed trajectories into natural-language feedback that a hypernetwork converts into low-rank weight updates at inference time, beating GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% on agentic tasks.

items.title: DRBench Pro scores deep research agents on knowledge coverage
items.summary: A benchmark of 144 cases across 24 domains with 44,102 evidence-grounded rubrics; the best of 16 deep research agents reaches 57.04% overall coverage.

items.title: Sber's GigaChat 4 open weights resurface: 708B/41B-active and 37B/4B-active MoEs
items.summary: The first fully open release from Russia's frontier-model ecosystem is drawing fresh attention: a 710B MoE with 41B active under MIT and a 38B/4B-active sibling, both with GGUF and bf16 variants. Checkpoints landed Nov 20 but the collection resurfaced Nov 26.

items.title: NVIDIA opens the Nemotron 3.5 Parse recipe: 19M synthetic samples and a DFlash2 speculator
items.summary: Three training datasets (9.98M synthetic charts, 1M tables, 7.9M multilingual OCR pages), an NeMo SFT+GRPO recipe, and a draft model that lifted single-pass throughput 7.62x on one H200. GRPO cut loop-flagged pages by ~77% over SFT alone.

items.title: Z.ai says GLM-5.5 is not delayed, still targeting a December open-weights launch
items.summary: Z.ai publicly clarified its next flagship has not slipped after community chatter, confirming a December window that r/LocalLLaMA reads as the last major open-weights drop of the year alongside Kimi K3.1 and DeepSeek V4.1.

items.title: ISTA-DASLab ships non-uniform GGUF quants: Inkling-2-Mini at 3.5 bpw keeps 99.2% of base
items.summary: GSQ-RCO GGUFs at 2.75–3.5 bits per weight assign a separate quantization type to each of 169 tensors via a budget-constrained Riemannian search; the recommended IQ3_S build lands within one point of the BF16-class base on AIME25, GPQA-Diamond and LiveCodeBench v6.

items.title: Nullify 68M: local PII detection at 8.5 ms per message
items.summary: A 68M-parameter token classifier scores 86.6 F1 on Privacy-Bench, ahead of the OpenAI Privacy Filter 1.5B (73.3) and GLiNER2 PII (84.6). Apache 2.0, ONNX or PyTorch, ~0.7 GB of memory, built as a local redaction filter in front of cloud LLM calls.

items.title: ggml publishes a public llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.summary: Tracks PP512 and TG128 throughput across builds, models and quantizations for Radeon 8060S and AI Pro R9700S, refreshed by weekly GitHub Actions runs, with bench data readable from a public storage bucket.

items.title: Moat by Command Code: a $5/mo subscription alternative to per-token model routing
items.summary: Moat pools subscribers' usage to buy frontier models at wholesale prices, offering 40–70% off models such as GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3. HN commenters note the subscription model is not a drop-in replacement for pay-per-token routing.

items.title: minipg: PostgreSQL as a single executable
items.summary: Runs Postgres 18 Alpine as one executable with no Docker, VM or Linux kernel — the database lives in a portable .pgdb directory and the server starts on demand. The author warns it is roughly 2x slower than native and early-stage.

items.title: Fleetify: open-source command center for AI coding agents
items.summary: A free desktop app for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven other agents side by side, with status, spend, tokens and live activity per session; each task gets its own git worktree, dev-server preview and PR.

items.title: AgentDesign: make your coding agent draw every screen before it writes code
items.summary: A macOS review app has Claude Code, Codex or Cursor generate screen designs first, letting developers annotate and approve before any code is written; every version is kept as plain files locally. Free unlimited demo, $29 one-time license.

items.title: Kaju: annotate, comment and collaborate with Claude Code in the terminal
items.summary: Select text in Claude Code's terminal output, hit a hotkey and send a quoted comment straight back to the agent, or collect comments and send them as one numbered review. Makes no network connections.

items.title: Delos Data raises over $100M Series A for AI inference interconnects
items.summary: Led by Socratic Partners with Matrix, Playground, Technology Impact Fund, Matter Venture Partners and IAG participating. Delos builds Nonstop AI, a chip-and-software interconnect platform for inference clusters; server sampling is targeted for end of 2026.

items.title: Lute raises $20M across pre-seed and seed for touch-based robot models
items.summary: The Warsaw–San Mateo startup launched Lute-0, a video-action robot model combining tactile sensor data with wrist-camera video, claiming parity or better versus open-source pi-0.5 on internal retail tasks at half the latency.

items.title: GeneSight raises over RMB 100M angel round for AI virtual-cell drug development
items.summary: Led by Huagai Capital, the Beijing startup builds virtual-cell models that predict how drug candidates affect human cells and patient subgroups, and reports paid projects with pharma clients.

items.title: NVISION completes Pre-A and Pre-A+ rounds for AI data-center optical interconnects
items.summary: The Xi'an silicon photonics company, which makes optical engines up to 6.4T for AI data-center links, closed rounds totaling hundreds of millions of yuan led by Shanghai Science and Technology Innovation Group and Matrix Partners China.

items.title: Nextesy raises $10.4M seed led by Swisscom Ventures for AI bookkeeping
items.summary: The Zurich startup automates accounting workflows for SMEs, freelancers and fiduciaries with AI agents, claiming ~98% bookkeeping accuracy and 2,000+ active customers.
